verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 9 页 Results 3.2 末段，Figure 3D，'Interestingly, when both the initial yeast extract and peptone concentrations were doubled, the total taxane titer improved 5.4-fold to 108 mg/L'

verified_claims.claim: 微尺度 DSD 14 组中 Medium 1 总紫杉烷 229 ± 6 mg/L；Medium 11 与 14 分别 195 ± 26 与 218 ± 32 mg/L。
verified_claims.evidence: 'medium one presented the highest total taxane titer of 229 ± 6 mg/L. Media combinations 11 and 14 also produced high taxane titers of 195 ± 26 and 218 ± 32 mg/L, respectively'

verified_claims.claim: DSD 模型给出初始 OD600（p=0.011）、酵母提取物（p=0.028）、半乳糖浓度（p=0.011）三个显著主效应，初始 OD600 二次项 p=0.007；最优酵母提取物 45 g/L、半乳糖 45 g/L、初始 OD600=0.74；预测滴度 232.15 mg/L，95% CI [181.27, 283.03]，desirability 0.9883。
verified_claims.evidence: 'initial OD600 (p = 0.011) along with yeast extract (p = 0.028) and galactose concentrations (p = 0.011)... non-linearity of the effect of initial OD600 (p = 0.007)... optimal initial yeast extract and galactose concentration was 45 g/L, and initial OD600 had an optimal value of around 0.74'；Figure 6 标注 '232.15 [181.27, 283.03]' 与 '0.9883'

verified_claims.claim: 1 L BIOSTAT 验证培养总税表滴度 387 ± 6 mg/L（较模型预测提升约 1.7 倍）；T5αAc 在 3.4.2 节报告 21 ± 0.3 mg/L（约 6 倍文献 [8]）；摘要与结论给出 22 mg/L（约 2 倍）。原文内部存在 21 vs 22 与 6 倍 vs 2 倍两种表述并存。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 13 页 Results 3.4.2 与 PDF 第 2 页 Abstract 第 14 页 Conclusions
verified_claims.evidence: 'The desired TAT product, T5αAc, was detected with a maximum titer of 21 ± 0.3 mg/L, representing an almost 6-fold improvement, compared to the previous literature [8]'；'The total taxane titer was 387 ± 6 mg/L, representing a 1.7-fold improvement compared with that predicted by the statistical model'；'T5αAc, was improved two-fold to 22 mg/L, compared to the previous maxima for the strain'

As the visualization of the cells at 32 h (Figure 2C) revealed the expected budding morphology'
